text_en: When Demetrius heard that Nicanor and his army had fallen in battle, he sent Bacchides and Alcimus into the land of Judah a second time, and with them the right wing of the army.
text_cn: 德默特琉听说，尼加诺尔已经阵亡，军队已覆没，便再派遣巴基德和阿耳基慕，率领右翼军，到犹太地去。

text_en: They went by the road that leads to Gilgal and encamped against Mesaloth in Arbela, and they took it and killed many people.
text_cn: 他们沿着通往加里肋亚的大道前行，包围了阿尔贝拉的买撒罗特，攻陷那地方，杀死很多人。

text_en: In the first month of the one hundred fifty-second year they encamped against Jerusalem;
text_cn: 一百五十二年正月， 面对耶路撒冷安营。

text_en: then they marched off and went to Berea with twenty thousand foot soldiers and two thousand cavalry.
text_cn: 但以后又拔营，领着步兵两万，骑兵两千，前往贝尔则特。

text_en: Now Judas was encamped in Elasa, and with him were three thousand picked men.
text_cn: 同时犹大带着精兵三千，在厄拉撒驻扎。

text_en: When they saw the huge number of the enemy forces, they were greatly frightened, and many slipped away from the camp, until no more than eight hundred of them were left.
text_cn: 犹太人见敌军人数众多，都很害怕，于是许多人离营潜逃，剩下的仅八百人。

text_en: When Judas saw that his army had slipped away and the battle was imminent, he was crushed in spirit, for he had no time to assemble them.
text_cn: 犹大见自己的军队潜逃，战事又迫于眉睫，心中焦急，已来不及集合兵马；

text_en: He became faint, but he said to those who were left, “Let us get up and go against our enemies. We may have the strength to fight them. ”
text_cn: 遂失意地对剩下的人说：“起来，去攻打敌人，也许能与他们对抗！”

text_en: But they tried to dissuade him, saying, “We do not have the strength. Let us rather save our own lives now, and let us come back with our kindred and fight them; we are too few. ”
text_cn: 他们劝阻他说：“我们不能去！现在只可逃命！不如回去联合我们的弟兄，再与他们决战，因为我们人数太少！”

text_en: But Judas said, “Far be it from us to do such a thing as to flee from them. If our time has come, let us die bravely for our kindred, and leave no cause to question our honor. ”
text_cn: 犹大说：“逃走！我决不逃。若时机到来，我们要为我们的兄弟勇敢牺牲，决不可失掉我们的光荣。”

text_en: Then the army of Bacchides marched out from the camp and took its stand for the encounter. The cavalry was divided into two companies, and the slingers and the archers went ahead of the army, as did all the chief warriors.
text_cn: 敌军从营里冲出，犹太人便去迎战。这时敌骑分成两翼，投石手与弓手行在军队前面，前锋都是勇士，巴基德坐镇右翼。

text_en: Bacchides was on the right wing. Flanked by the two companies, the phalanx advanced to the sound of the trumpets; and the men with Judas also blew their trumpets.
text_cn: 敌军两翼进攻时，吹起号角，犹大方面的人也吹起号角。

text_en: The earth was shaken by the noise of the armies, and the battle raged from morning until evening.
text_cn: 于是两军喊声震地，从早到晚，在混战中。

text_en: Judas saw that Bacchides and the strength of his army were on the right; then all the stouthearted men went with him,
text_cn: 犹大见巴基德和军队主力都在右翼，就集合所有勇敢的人，专攻右翼；

text_en: and they crushed the right wing, and he pursued them as far as Mount Azotus.
text_cn: 右翼便被他们击溃，他们将敌人追到阿左托山。

text_en: When those on the left wing saw that the right wing was crushed, they turned and followed close behind Judas and his men.
text_cn: 敌军左翼见右翼败退，便转身从背后追击犹大及其军队。

text_en: The battle became desperate, and many on both sides were wounded and fell.
text_cn: 战事十分激烈，双方死伤甚重。

text_en: Judas also fell, and the rest fled.
text_cn: 犹大也阵亡了，其余的人也都逃散。

text_en: Then Jonathan and Simon took their brother Judas and buried him in the tomb of their ancestors at Modein,
text_cn: 约纳堂便和息孟，将他们的兄弟犹大抬回，埋葬在摩丁城的祖茔（yíng）里。

text_en: and wept for him. All Israel made great lamentation for him; they mourned many days and said,
text_cn: 全以色列都痛哭他，非常悲哀，一连多日哀悼他说：

text_en: “How is the mighty fallen, the savior of Israel! ”
text_cn: “拯救以色列的英雄，怎会阵亡？”

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Judas, and his wars and the brave deeds that he did, and his greatness, have not been recorded, but they were very many.
text_cn: 犹大其余的言行，所立的战功，英勇的事迹，和他的伟大，都没有记载出来，因为实在太多了。

text_en: After the death of Judas, the renegades emerged in all parts of Israel; all the wrongdoers reappeared.
text_cn: 犹大死后，以色列各地的歹徒，都蜂拥而起，作恶的人也乘机而兴，

text_en: In those days a very great famine occurred, and the country went over to their side.
text_cn: 因为那时正逢大荒年，当地的人多起而附和。

text_en: Bacchides chose the godless and put them in charge of the country.
text_cn: 巴基德便选出一些歹徒，派定他们主管那地方；

text_en: They made inquiry and searched for the friends of Judas, and brought them to Bacchides, who took vengeance on them and made sport of them.
text_cn: 他们便搜查犹大的朋友，逮捕后，解到巴基德前，让他报仇，虐待他们。

text_en: So there was great distress in Israel, such as had not been since the time that prophets ceased to appear among them.
text_cn: 以色列从此遭受大难，这大难是自他们没有先知那天起，从未遭遇过的。

text_en: Then all the friends of Judas assembled and said to Jonathan,
text_cn: 于是犹大的众朋友聚集起来，向约纳堂说：

text_en: “Since the death of your brother Judas there has been no one like him to go against our enemies and Bacchides, and to deal with those of our nation who hate us.
text_cn: “自从你兄弟犹大死后，没有一个像他的人出来，抵抗我们的仇敌和巴基德，以及仇视我们民族的人。

text_en: Now therefore we have chosen you today to take his place as our ruler and leader, to fight our battle. ”
text_cn: 所以我们今天推选你来代替他，作我们的领袖，领导我们作战。”

text_en: So Jonathan accepted the leadership at that time in place of his brother Judas.
text_cn: 约纳堂那时便接受了领袖的职位，起来代替他哥哥犹大。

text_en: When Bacchides learned of this, he tried to kill him.
text_cn: 巴基德一听说这事，便企图杀害他。

text_en: But Jonathan and his brother Simon and all who were with him heard of it, and they fled into the wilderness of Tekoa and camped by the water of the pool of Asphar.
text_cn: 约纳堂和他哥哥息孟以及他的众同志，知道这个消息后，便逃到特科亚旷野，驻扎在阿斯法尔水池旁。

text_en: Bacchides found this out on the sabbath day, and he with all his army crossed the Jordan.
text_cn: 【巴基德在安息日知道了这事，便率领他的全军，来到约但的彼岸。】

text_en: So Jonathan sent his brother as leader of the multitude and begged the Nabateans, who were his friends, for permission to store with them the great amount of baggage that they had.
text_cn: 约纳堂打发作军长的哥哥若望，去求他的朋友纳巴泰人，管理他们大批的装备。

text_en: But the family of Jambri from Medeba came out and seized John and all that he had, and left with it.
text_cn: 不料，杨布黎人从默达巴出来，捉住若望，且抢去他的一切所有，带着走了。

text_en: After these things it was reported to Jonathan and his brother Simon, “The family of Jambri are celebrating a great wedding, and are conducting the bride, a daughter of one of the great nobles of Canaan, from Nadabath with a large escort. ”
text_cn: 事后，有人报告约纳堂及他的兄弟息孟说：“杨布黎人现在正要举行隆重的婚礼，场面伟大，由纳达巴特迎娶新娘，她是客纳罕一个族长的女儿。”

text_en: Remembering how their brother John had been killed, they went up and hid under cover of the mountain.
text_cn: 那时他们便想起他们兄弟若望的血债，遂上去藏在山中隐密处。

text_en: They looked out and saw a tumultuous procession with a great amount of baggage; and the bridegroom came out with his friends and his brothers to meet them with tambourines and musicians and many weapons.
text_cn: 举目一望，看见一群喧嚷的人和大批的妆奁（lián），新郎和他的众朋友及兄弟，都出来迎接，其中有的敲鼓，有的奏乐，很多人还拿着武器。

text_en: Then they rushed on them from the ambush and began killing them. Many were wounded and fell, and the rest fled to the mountain; and the Jews took all their goods.
text_cn: 犹太人便从埋伏的地方起来，向他们冲去击杀，他们伤亡的很多，其余的都逃到山里去了，犹太人便抢得了他们所有的一切。

text_en: So the wedding was turned into mourning and the voice of their musicians into a funeral dirge.
text_cn: 如此，婚事变成了丧事，乐声变成了哀声。

text_en: After they had fully avenged the blood of their brother, they returned to the marshes of the Jordan.
text_cn: 他们为自己的兄弟报了血仇以后，就回到约但河的沼泽地方。

text_en: When Bacchides heard of this, he came with a large force on the sabbath day to the banks of the Jordan.
text_cn: 巴基德一听说这事，就在安息日率领大军，来到约但河畔。

text_en: And Jonathan said to those with him, “Let us get up now and fight for our lives, for today things are not as they were before.
text_cn: 那时约纳堂向部下说：“现在应当起来，应为保全生命而战，今天决不像昨天或前天一样。

text_en: For look! the battle is in front of us and behind us; the water of the Jordan is on this side and on that, with marsh and thicket; there is no place to turn.
text_cn: 战争就在我们前后进行，这里有约但河水，那边有沼泽和丛林，决没有退却的地方。

text_en: Cry out now to Heaven that you may be delivered from the hands of our enemies. ”
text_cn: 所以现在应向上天呼吁，援救你们脱离仇敌的手。”

text_en: So the battle began, and Jonathan stretched out his hand to strike Bacchides, but he eluded him and went to the rear.
text_cn: 双方于是交战，约纳堂伸手要杀巴基德，巴基德却脱身逃了。

text_en: Then Jonathan and the men with him leaped into the Jordan and swam across to the other side, and the enemy did not cross the Jordan to attack them.
text_cn: 约纳堂便同他的部下，跳进约但河，游到对岸，敌人并未过约但河追击。

text_en: And about one thousand of Bacchides’ men fell that day.
text_cn: 那一天，巴基德方面死亡的约一千人。

text_en: Then Bacchides returned to Jerusalem and built strong cities in Judea: the fortress in Jericho, and Emmaus, and Beth-horon, and Bethel, and Timnath, and Pharathon, and Tephon, with high walls and gates and bars.
text_cn: 巴基德回到耶路撒冷，在犹太各城修筑防御工事，又修建高墙，安上大门和闩，巩固了耶里哥、厄玛乌、贝特曷龙、贝特耳、提默纳达、法辣通、特丰等地所有的堡垒；

text_en: And he placed garrisons in them to harass Israel.
text_cn: 在那里驻扎了守卫队，与以色列为敌；

text_en: He also fortified the town of Beth-zur, and Gazara, and the citadel, and in them he put troops and stores of food.
text_cn: 且巩固了贝特族尔城，革则尔和耶路撒冷的堡垒，派军队驻扎在那里，并贮存了食粮，

text_en: And he took the sons of the leading men of the land as hostages and put them under guard in the citadel at Jerusalem.
text_cn: 又把当地首领的孩子，带去作质，囚禁在耶路撒冷的堡垒里，

text_en: In the one hundred and fifty-third year, in the second month, Alcimus gave orders to tear down the wall of the inner court of the sanctuary. He tore down the work of the prophets!
text_cn: 一百五十三年二月，阿耳基慕下令拆毁圣所内院的墙，就是拆毁先知们修建的工程， 但他只能开始拆墙，

text_en: But he only began to tear it down, for at that time Alcimus was stricken and his work was hindered; his mouth was stopped and he was paralyzed, so that he could no longer say a word or give commands concerning his house.
text_cn: 因为那时候，阿耳基慕忽然得了病，他的工作因此被迫停止；他的口闭着，身子瘫痪，不能说话，也不能料理家事。

text_en: And Alcimus died at that time in great agony.
text_cn: 阿耳基慕就这样十分凄惨地死了。

text_en: When Bacchides saw that Alcimus was dead, he returned to the king, and the land of Judah had rest for two years.
text_cn: 巴基德见阿耳基慕已死，回到国王那里，犹太地方于是两年得享平安。

text_en: Then all the lawless plotted and said, “See! Jonathan and his men are living in quiet and confidence. So now let us bring Bacchides back, and he will capture them all in one night. ”
text_cn: 那时，犹太人中的一般歹徒又商议说：“看，约纳堂和他的部下，已安心生活，一无所惧，所以现在我们要引巴基德来，一夜之间，把他们一网打尽。”

text_en: And they went and consulted with him.
text_cn: 于是他们去向他建议。

text_en: He started to come with a large force, and secretly sent letters to all his allies in Judea, telling them to seize Jonathan and his men; but they were unable to do it, because their plan became known.
text_cn: 巴基德起身，带领大军前来，同时暗中给他在犹太的一切同僚去信，叫他们逮捕约纳堂和他的部下；但是他们没有办到，因为计划已被泄漏。

text_en: And Jonathan’s men seized about fifty of the men of the country who were leaders in this treachery, and killed them.
text_cn: 约纳堂的部下，反而从当地人中，逮捕了这事的罪魁五十名，尽行杀死。

text_en: Then Jonathan with his men, and Simon, withdrew to Bethbasi in the wilderness; he rebuilt the parts of it that had been demolished, and they fortified it.
text_cn: 约纳堂和息孟及他的部下，随后退入旷野，到了贝特巴息，将那里已毁坏的地方，重加修建及巩固。

text_en: When Bacchides learned of this, he assembled all his forces, and sent orders to the men of Judea.
text_cn: 巴基德知道了这事，就集合他的大军，又通知犹太地的党羽；

text_en: Then he came and encamped against Bethbasi; he fought against it for many days and made machines of war.
text_cn: 便来面对贝特巴息安营，制造军械，攻打了多日。

text_en: But Jonathan left his brother Simon in the town, while he went out into the country; and he went with only a few men.
text_cn: 约纳堂留下哥哥息孟在城里把守，自己带着一批人去了乡下，

text_en: He struck down Odomera and his kindred and the people of Phasiron in their tents.
text_cn: 袭击住在帐幕中的敖多默辣，和他的兄弟们，以及法息龙的后裔。这些人也随他作战，部队也随着扩大。

text_en: Then he began to attack and went into battle with his forces; and Simon and his men sallied out from the town and set fire to the machines of war.
text_cn: 那时，息孟也率领部下，突出城外，焚毁了敌方的军械。

text_en: They fought with Bacchides, and he was crushed by them. They pressed him very hard, for his plan and his expedition had been in vain.
text_cn: 于是双方夹攻，巴基德大败，因此十分懊丧，因为他的计谋与战略都落了空，

text_en: So he was very angry at the renegades who had counseled him to come into the country, and he killed many of them. Then he decided to go back to his own land.
text_cn: 便对那些给他献计，劝他来此地的歹徒泄怒，将他们中许多人杀死，然后决意回国。

text_en: When Jonathan learned of this, he sent ambassadors to him to make peace with him and obtain release of the captives.
text_cn: 约纳堂一知道了，就打发使者到他那里，与他和谈，要求交还俘虏。

text_en: He agreed, and did as he said; and he swore to Jonathan that he would not try to harm him as long as he lived.
text_cn: 巴基德接受了，也按他所说的话行了，还向他发誓，有生之日，不再谋害他，

text_en: He restored to him the captives whom he had taken previously from the land of Judah; then he turned and went back to his own land, and did not come again into their territory.
text_cn: 遂把以前在犹太地掳去的俘虏，交还给约纳堂，然后回本国去了；此后再不打算来犯犹太国境。

text_en: Thus the sword ceased from Israel. Jonathan settled in Michmash and began to judge the people; and he destroyed the godless out of Israel.
text_cn: 以色列地干戈于是止息。约纳堂住在米革玛斯，开始治理百姓，且将歹徒由以色列中除尽。
